title: Israel conflict z>1 leads VIX
hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] Israel conflict-event count 20d z-score > 1 leads VIX higher by 0-1 days (+); trade long VIX exposure 2d [gdelt.isr.conflict_events -> finance.^VIX.close]
message: Weakly supported: r=0.09 (n=391), best lag -1d r=0.13; long-VIX rule hit rate 42%, sharpe-like 0.07, actionability 2.78 - not tradeable

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.isr.conflict_events rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long ^VIX next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] Israel fight-event count 20d z-score > 2 leads VIX log-return higher by 1 day (+); tighter threshold, trade long VIX exposure 1d [gdelt.isr.fight_events -> finance.^VIX.log_return] (parent: R2-0090)
